title: Analytics filters
responsibility: Provides history filters through a normal GET form.

inputs.name: AnalyticsFilters.filters
inputs.description: Required initial loop, task, model and optional since/until values. Missing values become empty; dates use their first ten characters. These initialize input defaults rather than live bindings.

outputs.name: AnalyticsFilters
outputs.description: Loop/task/model text fields and UTC-day date inputs submitting to the analytics page, plus a reset link. Explains that live CPU is unaffected. Filtering and invalid-date handling occur outside this component.
